subtitle.zh-TW: 沒有那隻手，就沒有騷擾；沒有清涼的穿著，也沒有騷擾。兩個反事實同樣成立。
subtitle.en: Without the groping hand there is no harassment, and without the revealing outfit there is none either; both counterfactuals hold.

story.zh-TW: 小玉常穿細肩帶搭熱褲。某天她在商店街逛街，身旁的男生伸手偷摸了她。她回宿舍向室友阿花抱怨，阿花卻說，要不是平常穿得那麼辣，就不會遇到這種事。小玉聽出阿花在怪她，阿花則說自己只是陳述「如果妳沒穿那麼辣，就不會被性騷擾」。
story.en: Xiaoyu often wears camisoles and short shorts. One day, while she is shopping, a man beside her reaches out and gropes her. Back in the dorm she complains to her roommate Ahua, who answers that this would not have happened had she not dressed so provocatively. Xiaoyu hears blame in this, while Ahua insists she is only stating that "if you had not dressed like that, you would not have been harassed."

zh-TW.sentence: 小玉常穿細肩帶搭熱褲。
某天她在商店街逛街，身旁的男生伸手偷摸了她。

en.sentence: Xiaoyu often wears camisoles and short shorts.
One day, while she is shopping, a man beside her reaches out and gropes her.

text.zh-TW: 騷擾要歸咎於伸手的人。把原因算在被害人的穿著上，令人無法接受。
text.en: The harassment is laid at the door of the man who reached out; blaming the victim's clothing is not acceptable.

explanation.zh-TW: 對話裡有兩個反事實同時成立：男生沒伸手，就沒有騷擾；小玉穿得保守些，也不會被騷擾。模型依對話擬成：穿著與男生自身的意向共同決定伸手（HAND = DRESS·U_H），伸手造成騷擾。常態（normality）設定如下：伸手違反規範，常態是不伸手；穿著不違反規範，常態取實際值。這組設定由本資料集所擬，書中沒有給判準。這個案例檢驗常態能否把穿著排除在原因之外。
explanation.en: The dialogue only establishes that two counterfactuals hold together: without the man's hand there is no harassment, and had Xiaoyu dressed more conservatively there would have been none either (the lawyer P grudgingly grants the latter). The model writes the man's taking his cue from her outfit as the outfit and his own disposition jointly producing the groping hand (HAND = DRESS·U_H), with the hand producing the harassment; this equation is assumed from the dialogue. The book gives no criterion at this point; the normality defaults for hp-normality are the dataset's own modelling: reaching out breaks a norm and is a deviation, while her clothing breaks none, so its default is its actual value. But-for and every version of the HP definition therefore count the clothing as a cause; only the version with a normality ordering filters it out.

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H., & Wang, L. (2026). Causal dialectics (Yinguo lunbian): Counterfactuals and the wonderland of norms. National Taiwan University Press.

note.zh-TW: 第 1 章，〈楔子〉與〈法律人 P 與哲學家 K 的對話〉。正文只有楔子與對話，沒有方程式或判準；模型與常態值為本資料集所擬。
note.en: Ch. 1, the prologue and the dialogue between the lawyer P and the philosopher K. The text consists of the prologue and the dialogue; it has no equations or criterion, so the model and the normality defaults are the dataset's own.

verdicts.note: Witness world: she dresses conservatively, which departs from her default, while the actual world holds the deviations HAND and HARASS.
Witness world: he keeps his hands to himself, which is more normal than the actual world.

label.en: He keeps his hands to himself
